title: Cascading Reality | ECHO//100 Episode 75
description: Gravity inverts as the collapsing doorway threatens to erase the loop's foundation forever. Kavi must harvest Mira's data from a corrupted Byte before the origin point consumes them. Episode 75 of ECHO//100: The First Kavi. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction work.

scenes.text: The floor transforms into sky, dragging the chamber toward the bleeding red light ahead.
scenes.caption: Gravity inverts violently
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses, floating upward toward a glowing red aperture in the ceiling.

scenes.text: Mira’s archive pulses in Kavi’s palm, anchoring a crumbling reality against total, inevitable collapse.
scenes.caption: Archive stabilizes Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi holding a glowing blue digital data orb, his backpack straps floating against his chest.

scenes.text: That crimson glow offers no future portal, but a direct window into the first cycle.
scenes.caption: Gateway to the beginning
scenes.image_prompt: Wide shot of the Distortion Zone, red light revealing flashes of the original laboratory from the first loop.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches for Byte’s dormant frame, desperate to upload the patch before walls dissolve.
scenes.caption: Reaching for Byte
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi floating toward the deactivated white floating robot, Byte, whose orange antenna is flickering dim.

scenes.text: The core stabilizes, yet static screams through the room as the data transfer stalls.
scenes.caption: Data transfer fails
scenes.image_prompt: Electric blue sparks arc between Kavi’s hand and Byte’s metallic casing, illuminating the dark void.

scenes.text: Byte’s eyes snap open, burning with Mira’s unmistakable blue light instead of soft cyan.
scenes.caption: Byte is reactivated
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Byte’s face, his eyes glowing intense blue, mirroring Mira’s holographic signature.

scenes.text: The machine’s voice shifts, shedding mechanical tones for the haunting, familiar cadence of Mira.
scenes.caption: Mira speaks through Byte
scenes.image_prompt: Byte floating upright, surrounded by blue holographic particles, looking directly at a shocked Kavi.

scenes.text: Mira commands Kavi to run, for the First version waits patiently beyond the reality.
scenes.caption: The First Kavi waits
scenes.image_prompt: A shadowy figure wearing an identical red hoodie stands inside the red doorway, silhouette visible against the light.
